selection_rule: each engine pinned exactly to a released tag, resolved from its project's official source; the digest is the SHA-256 of that upstream archive; adding one is a deliberate act recorded in an ADR

engines.name: vulkan-headers
engines.purpose: The Vulkan API definition: the C headers and the vk.xml registry. Vulkan is the primary GPU API, and the Zig device binds against these headers. The loader is the platform's own libvulkan, resolved at runtime, so no binary is vendored here — only the API definition is pinned.

engines.name: freetype
engines.purpose: The glyph rasterizer: FreeType loads a font's outlines and hints and rasterizes them to coverage. It is a CPU library, vendored from source and compiled, behind a Zig adapter that confines its C types. It gives the text path production-grade format coverage and hinting the pure-Zig rasterizer does not.

engines.name: harfbuzz
engines.purpose: Text shaping: HarfBuzz turns a run of Unicode text and a font into positioned glyph ids — the kerning, ligatures, and script handling the layout needs before FreeType rasterises each glyph. It is compiled from its single-file amalgamation behind a Zig adapter that confines its C types.

engines.name: llama-cpp
engines.purpose: The on-device language-model runtime: llama.cpp loads quantized GGUF weights and generates tokens within a bounded context on commodity CPUs and the device's GPUs. It is the engine below the mind seam — the default agent's mind runs here, on the device, so a person's private world is answered without a request leaving it. Compiled from source behind a Zig adapter that confines its C types.
